---
Test
---
!3 !-FitNesseMcp-! server

|script                 |!-SlimProxy.Mcp-!                                                      |
|ensure                 |mcp start;|..\..\Projects\FitNesseMcp\FitNesseMcp.exe                  |
|$StartInstanceResponse=|mcp call; |start_instance  |{"instance":"SlimForDelphi"}               |
|$ListInstancesResponse=|mcp call; |list_instances  |{}                                         |
|$PageContentResponse=  |mcp call; |get_page_content|{"pagePath":"FrontPage"}                   |
|$ListPageResponse=     |mcp call; |list_pages      |{"pagePath":"WDProject", "recursive": true}|
|mcp stop                                                                                       |

|script|!-SlimProxy.StringTester-!|$StartInstanceResponse                                         |
|ensure|matches                   |(Instance is already running!-|-!Instance started successfully)|

|script|!-SlimProxy.StringTester-!|$ListInstancesResponse    |
|ensure|contains                  |!-SlimForDelphi-!         |
|check |contains count            |!-\"isRunning\":true-!|>=1|

|script|!-SlimProxy.StringTester-!|$PageContentResponse                                                           |
|ensure|contains                  |!-''The fully integrated stand-alone acceptance testing framework and wiki.''-!|

|script|!-SlimProxy.StringTester-!|$ListPageResponse                                                                    |
|ensure|contains                  |!-{\"name\":\"Basics\",\"type\":\"Test\",\"path\":\"WDProject.FitNesseMcp.Basics\"}-!|
